audit.whatIsWrong: Content and full read Graves/Graves/Graves/Zac/Graves/Zac/Zac. The packet chart reads Zac/Skill/Graves/Skill/Zac/Zac/Zac, and the already-audited mirror (zac__graves) records 'Aligned full.phases[1] and [2] to Graves'. Taking the mirror as binding on rows 1 and 2 and the packet elsewhere gives Zac/Graves/Graves/Skill/Zac/Zac/Zac. The page's own prose agrees on the disputed rows it covers — whys[0] opens 'Zac wins Level 1', whys[3] 'Skill window 4-5', whys[4] 'Zac owns 6'.
audit.why: Level 1 and level 6 were both flipped to Graves against the page's own text. Level 1 is where a Graves has to stand inside Unstable Matter's 350 range to deal damage at all, and level 6 is where four knockups from Let's Bounce! erase his kiting.
audit.corrected: win[0] and phases[0] to Zac, win[3]/phases[3] to Skill, win[4]/phases[4] to Zac; rows 1 and 2 left on Graves to match the mirror; ratings 3/6/7/5/3/3/2.

audit.whatIsWrong: The packet flags zero sequencing cues and no cooldown appears anywhere, on a page whose stated win condition is 'Elastic Slingshot down, wave right, go'.
audit.why: Elastic Slingshot is 21/18/15/12/9s and Let's Bounce! is 120/105/90s. A whiffed E at rank 1 is 21 seconds of free lane; at rank 5 it is 9 and the plan no longer works.
audit.corrected: 21s added to phases[3], spikes[2], early and wants.you[1]; 120s added to mid.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three missing mechanics and the usual Graves-side fabrications. MISSING: (1) Cell Division's revive — Riot's text says fatal damage splits Zac into 4 bloblets and he revives if any survive. The page talks about 'blob sustain' repeatedly but never says that killing him does not necessarily kill him. (2) Unstable Matter is never mentioned at all: 350 range, 5-second cooldown, percentage of MAXIMUM HEALTH as magic damage — which is the entire reason standing at Graves' point-blank range is expensive here. (3) The mirror's key finding: Graves' four bullets cannot pass through units, so where he reloads relative to the minion line decides whether his damage exists. FABRICATIONS: 'second E charge' and 'only one Quickdraw charge' (Quickdraw is one dash on 16/15/14/13/12s refreshed by landing autos), 'Smoke Screen blind' three times (it reduces sight range and slows), 'Q cone' (Q detonates; the cone is R), and 'R as the disengage knockback' (no displacement in its text).
audit.why: A Graves who spends a 100-second Collateral Damage to finish Zac and gets a revived Zac has lost the fight and the next ninety seconds. And the advice 'stand point-blank and unload' is written as if it were free, when Unstable Matter charges percent max health every 5 seconds for the privilege.
audit.corrected: Revive added to whys[4], spikes[3] and late; Unstable Matter added to whys[0] and phases[0]; minion-block added to early per the mirror; all four fabrications removed.

edits.before: You out-skirmish but the crit scalers pass you — convert to picks with smoke-screen blinds and R snipes.

edits.before: Play assassin-marksman: smoke their engage, E through fights for armor, and save R as either the execute or the peel knockback. Crit carries out-DPS you — picks don't care.
edits.after: Play assassin-marksman: smoke their engage, E through fights for armor, and never spend the 100-second R on a Zac who can revive off bloblets. Crit carries out-DPS you.

edits.before: Your W smoke blinds tower dives and breaks gank pathing — drop it on arrival and turn their 2v1 into a coin flip you win.
edits.after: Your W smoke nearsights tower dives and breaks gank pathing — drop it on arrival and turn their 2v1 into a coin flip you win.

edits.before: Zac wins Level 1 — you have one ability and only one Quickdraw charge, and even a clumsy blob can soak your point-blank shells and trade back while you're stuck in his face to deal damage.
edits.after: Zac wins Level 1 — you have one ability and no Quickdraw yet, and standing in his face for damage means eating Unstable Matter, which costs a percentage of your maximum health.

edits.before: Roughly even at 2 — you get a second ability but no Smoke Screen yet, and he can't sling-engage you for a free pick, so neither side fully commits.
edits.after: Level 2 tips to you — your second ability lands and he cannot sling-engage yet, so a short point-blank trade is the safest one you get all lane.

edits.before: Your one stage: at 3 your Quickdraw weave-in, point-blank shell burst, and Smoke Screen blind let you win a short melee trade before he reaches blob sustain.
edits.after: Your one stage: at 3 the Quickdraw weave-in, point-blank shell burst and a Smoke Screen that cuts his sight win a short trade before blob sustain arrives.

edits.before: Zac owns 6 — his R flings and re-bounces you so your kiting is worthless, and his blob regen out-lasts your Collateral Damage burst.
edits.after: Zac owns 6 — Let's Bounce! knocks you up on four bounces so kiting is worthless, and killing him only splits him into four bloblets.

edits.after: Quickdraw and Smoke Screen are both online — your one real window. Dash in, dump a point-blank shell spread, and drop the smoke on him so he loses sight of you while you reload behind the minion line.

edits.after: Collateral Damage can't out-burst a blob healing off his passive cells, and Let's Bounce! knocks you up on each of four bounces — kiting is meaningless when he resets your position, and a gank usually rides the engage.

edits.before: His long-range E is his only real pick threat: it pulls him in from off-screen, knocks you up, and tees up a gank — never hug your own side wall while it's up, since the launch lands you deep with no Quickdraw escape angle.
edits.after: His long-range E is his only real pick threat: it pulls him in from off-screen, knocks you up, and tees up a gank — never hug your own side wall while Elastic Slingshot is up, 21s at rank 1, since you have one dash to spend.

edits.before: His passive blobs out-heal your shell DPS and your Eclipse/Serpent's burst bounces off his HP stacks; he becomes a multi-engage frontline tank while you're a melee-range, two-shell-magazine skirmisher with no kill pressure on him.
edits.after: His passive blobs out-heal your shell DPS and fatal damage only splits him into four bloblets that recombine and revive him; he becomes a multi-engage frontline while you're a melee-range, two-shell skirmisher with no kill pressure.

edits.before: Zac is squishy and clumsy at Level 1, but with one ability and no second Quickdraw charge you concede that first window anyway. Your real shot is the Level 2-3 spike: dash in with Quickdraw, dump a point-blank shell spread, then drop Smoke Screen directly on him so his return autos and Q poke miss while you reload your two shells — that makes the trade one-sided. The danger is his E sling: if it's up, never hug your own side wall, because he'll launch in from off-screen, knock you up, and burst you with a jungler on top. Bait that engage out and the lane stays survivable.
edits.after: Zac is squishy and clumsy at Level 1, but with one ability and no Quickdraw yet you concede that first window anyway. Your real shot is the Level 2-3 spike: dash in with Quickdraw, dump a point-blank shell spread, then drop Smoke Screen directly on him so he loses sight of you while you reload. Your four bullets cannot pass through units, so reload behind the minion line, never beside it. The danger is his E sling: while it is up — 21s at rank 1 — never hug your own side wall, because he'll launch in from off-screen, knock you up, and burst you with a jungler on top.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 your stacked Quickdraw armor/MR and second E charge let you win a clean extended trade if you catch him with E down, but he's already walking over his passive cells to heal your shell damage back. Level 6 flips it hard: Collateral Damage can't out-burst a blob that's regenerating off blobs, and his R leaps in, flings you, and re-bounces — your kiting means nothing when he resets your position every cast. Only commit if both his E and R are down; otherwise farm safely and respect the displacement chain plus the gank it sets up.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 your stacked True Grit armor/MR and a Quickdraw your autos refresh let you win a clean extended trade if you catch him with E down, but he is already walking over his passive cells to heal your shell damage back. Level 6 flips it hard: Collateral Damage can't out-burst that regen, and Let's Bounce! knocks you up on four separate bounces on a 120-second cooldown — kiting means nothing when he resets your position each time. Only commit with both his E and R down; otherwise farm and respect the gank it sets up.

edits.before: This is lost on paper and you should play around it — Zac's passive blob sustain eats your point-blank shell DPS and your first-and-second-item burst just bounces off his HP. He scales into an unkillable multi-engage frontline; you scale into a short-range skirmisher with a two-shell magazine and no way to kite a champion who flings and re-bounces you. Your only path is a lead banked before 2 items: snowball off a baited E whiff, then leave lane to skirmish and pick off his carries, ending the game before his frontline value matters.
